title: Backpacks and a Hatbox  (双肩包与帽盒)

segments.t: 走上铺着明亮地毯的二楼平台，汉娜手捧一只条纹圆帽盒朝六号房走去，格雷厄姆肩扛两只绿色徒步背包往二号房走——恰好伊芙琳手里拿着琴谱打开了四号房的门。先听一遍对话。
Well, hello! Are we playing musical chairs with guest luggage before the concert?
Arthur checked in two rooms without his glasses right before the early-train call, Evelyn!
Did you say EARLY train?! What time is our honored mapmaker arriving today?!
Three sharp this afternoon, madam — three hours ahead of the printed card.
Good heavens! Caleb and I have not finished rehearsing the middle bridge of our duet!
Do not worry, Evelyn; here sits the striped hatbox safe and sound outside Room Six!
And both green backpacks are parked neatly on the bench beside Room Two.
Let me write two polite calligraphy cards so the guests swap brass tags at the desk.
Oh, thank you, Evelyn — your handwriting makes even a key mix-up look five-star!
Tuck one card on hook two, one card on hook six, problem solved before one.
Now tell me where Caleb is hiding — we need thirty solid minutes at that walnut piano!
He just walked through the courtyard gate — meet him inside Room Nine right now!
搬行李的队伍刚到走廊上，正巧撞见准备去练琴的伊芙琳女士。得知车次提前，大伙儿的节奏再次加快。我们逐句精听这一场。
Well, hello! Are we playing musical chairs with guest luggage before the concert?
'哎呀，你们好！音乐会还没开场，咱们这是拿客人的行李玩起抢椅子游戏了吗？' 伊芙琳看着两人又是抱帽盒又是背双肩包，忍不住幽默地拿“抢椅子游戏”打趣。musical chairs 常用来比喻混乱地换位置：
Are we playing musical chairs
注意 luggage 是典型的不可数名词，无论有多少件行李，词尾都绝不能加 -s：
with guest luggage
Arthur checked in two rooms without his glasses right before the early-train call, Evelyn!
'亚瑟在接到早班列车电话前没戴眼镜，结果给两间房办错了入住，伊芙琳！' 汉娜三言两语交代前因后果。英语提到随身物品如眼镜时一定要加上所有格，所以说 without his glasses：
Arthur checked in two rooms without his glasses
接着出现的 early-train 用连字符把两个词连在一起，变成一个整体修饰后面的 call“来电”：
the early-train call
Did you say EARLY train?! What time is our honored mapmaker arriving today?!
'你刚才说“早班”列车？！咱们敬重的制图大师今天几点到呀？！' 听到“早班列车”几个字，一向优雅的伊芙琳瞬间睁大眼睛，把 EARLY 整个重读出来确认：
Did you say EARLY train
紧接着她追问制图师到达的准确时间，honored 在美式英语里不加 u，同时用现在进行时询问今天即将到来的安排：
What time is our honored mapmaker arriving today
Three sharp this afternoon, madam — three hours ahead of the printed card.
'今天下午三点整，夫人——比印好的请柬时间足足早了三个小时。' 汉娜像管家一样恭敬回答，madam 是对女士非常体面的敬称：
Three sharp this afternoon, madam
用 ahead of 表示时间或进度“比……提前”：
three hours ahead of the printed card
Good heavens! Caleb and I have not finished rehearsing the middle bridge of our duet!
'我的天哪！我和凯勒布连二重奏中间的过渡乐段都还没排练完呢！' 伊芙琳也顾不上端着了，脱口喊出一句略带复古礼貌感的惊呼 Good heavens“天哪”，同时留意 finish 后面必须用动名词 rehearsing：
have not finished rehearsing
在音乐术语里，bridge 除了指桥梁，还指乐曲中承上启下的“过渡段、桥段”：
the middle bridge of our duet
Do not worry, Evelyn; here sits the striped hatbox safe and sound outside Room Six!
'别担心，伊芙琳；这只条纹帽盒已经安安稳稳放在六号房门外了！' 格雷厄姆赶紧汇报行李已经各就各位，用上了经典固定搭配 safe and sound，意思是“安然无恙、完好无损”：
here sits the striped hatbox safe and sound
介词 outside 说明帽盒就安稳地摆在六号房门外：
outside Room Six
And both green backpacks are parked neatly on the bench beside Room Two.
'两只绿色双肩包也都整整齐齐码放在二号房旁边的长凳上了。' 连带着两只绿背包也交代得清清楚楚。park 原本是“停车”，用到行李上带出一股整齐停靠的俏皮感：
both green backpacks are parked neatly
beside 再次登场，表示“紧挨在二号房旁边的长椅上”：
on the bench beside Room Two
Let me write two polite calligraphy cards so the guests swap brass tags at the desk.
'我来用花体字写两张客气的便条卡，好让客人在前台把黄铜钥匙牌换回来。' 热心的伊芙琳立刻主动请缨帮忙写告示牌。用 Let me 提出帮一把，calligraphy 指讲究的“书法、手写艺术字”：
Let me write two polite calligraphy cards
她的小卡片是为了请客人去前台“互换”铜牌，动词 swap 很口语，意思是“对调、交换”：
so the guests swap brass tags at the desk
Oh, thank you, Evelyn — your handwriting makes even a key mix-up look five-star!
'哦，太谢谢您了，伊芙琳——您的笔迹连钥匙拿错这种小插曲都能显得像五星级服务！' 汉娜喜出望外，大赞伊芙琳的一手好字。handwriting 指个人的“笔迹”，make 后面接“宾语 + 动词原形”表示“让某事看起来……”：
your handwriting makes even a key mix-up
形容像高级酒店那样气派周到，直接用复合形容词 five-star“五星级的”：
look five-star
Tuck one card on hook two, one card on hook six, problem solved before one.
'二号钩塞一张卡，六号钩塞一张卡，一点钟之前问题就全部搞定。' 格雷厄姆爽快拍板，动词 tuck 指把纸片稳稳地“塞进、别进”挂钩或缝隙里：
Tuck one card on hook two
结尾的 problem solved 省略了系动词，是口语里特别干脆利落的固定说法，相当于“问题搞定！”：
problem solved before one
Now tell me where Caleb is hiding — we need thirty solid minutes at that walnut piano!
'快告诉我凯勒布躲哪儿去了——我们得在那架胡桃木钢琴前扎扎实实练上三十分钟！' 既然前线稳定下来，伊芙琳立刻想起自己的头等大事——抓凯勒布练琴。hide 是“躲起来”，形容时间“实打实、整整不中断”可以用 solid：
tell me where Caleb is hiding
thirty solid minutes 就是“足足三十分钟、一刻不打折的练琴时间”：
thirty solid minutes at that walnut piano
He just walked through the courtyard gate — meet him inside Room Nine right now!
'他刚走进庭院大门——您现在就去九号房找他吧！' 汉娜刚巧看见凯勒布进了院门，walk through 指“走过、穿过”院门：
He just walked through the courtyard gate
最后一小句用祈使句 meet him 催着伊芙琳赶紧进屋找他“碰头汇合”：
meet him inside Room Nine
这一波突发状况总算全数接住了，现在，让我们按正常语速把这段走廊上的快节奏对话从头听一遍。
Well, hello! Are we playing musical chairs with guest luggage before the concert?
Arthur checked in two rooms without his glasses right before the early-train call, Evelyn!
Did you say EARLY train?! What time is our honored mapmaker arriving today?!
Three sharp this afternoon, madam — three hours ahead of the printed card.
Good heavens! Caleb and I have not finished rehearsing the middle bridge of our duet!
Do not worry, Evelyn; here sits the striped hatbox safe and sound outside Room Six!
And both green backpacks are parked neatly on the bench beside Room Two.
Let me write two polite calligraphy cards so the guests swap brass tags at the desk.
Oh, thank you, Evelyn — your handwriting makes even a key mix-up look five-star!
Tuck one card on hook two, one card on hook six, problem solved before one.
Now tell me where Caleb is hiding — we need thirty solid minutes at that walnut piano!
He just walked through the courtyard gate — meet him inside Room Nine right now!
行李归了位，手写卡片也摆妥当，这场接力棒直接传到了九号房的钢琴凳前！我们下次见。
See you soon!
